gloss: many, numerous, a great number of

definitions.gloss: many, numerous, a great number of
definitions.explanation: Emphasizes a large quantity or variety of things, often with a nuance of impressiveness or significance. Used as a noun modifier (数々の) or adverbially.

examples.japanese: {数々|かずかず}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{賞|しょう}→賞：03227_shou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
{数々|かずかず}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{困難|こんなん}→困難：01410_konnan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乗|の}り{越|こ}えて→乗り越える：04620_norikoeru⟧きた。

⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{数々|かずかず}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名作|めいさく}→名作：11869_meisaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{世|よ}→世：00424_yo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{送|おく}り{出|だ}した→送り出す：06085_okuridasu⟧⟦{偉大|いだい}→偉大：01798_idai⟧な⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧だ。
examples.english: He is a great author who produced numerous masterpieces.

notes:
USAGE:
{数々|かずかず} implies not just quantity but significance — it suggests an impressive collection of things. Most commonly used as {数々|かずかず}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun. It has a somewhat literary or formal tone and appears often in biographical or narrative contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {数々|かずかず}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{実績|じっせき}→実績：04214_jisseki⟧: numerous achievements
- {数々|かずかず}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{困難|こんなん}→困難：01410_konnan⟧: many hardships
- {数々|かずかず}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧: a wealth of experience
- {数々|かずかず}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{伝説|でんせつ}→伝説：11446_densetsu⟧: numerous legends

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧: many, a lot (casual, general-purpose)
- ⟦{多数|たすう}→多数：05612_tasuu⟧: a large number (formal, objective)
- {数々|かずかず}: many (literary, implies impressiveness)
